world.title: Trump announces $200bn in energy investments from South Korea
world.summary: President Donald Trump announced $200 billion in energy investments from South Korea, including $54 billion for a liquefied natural gas (LNG) project in Alaska. The announcement was made at the White House on Wednesday, as Trump aims to highlight the Republican Party's economic achievements ahead of the upcoming US midterm elections. The investments are part of broader economic initiatives.

world.title: Second judge blocks Trump's $100,000 fee for new H-1B worker visas
world.summary: A second federal judge has blocked President Donald Trump's $100,000 fee on new H-1B visas for highly skilled foreign workers. This ruling follows a similar decision by another judge, challenging the legality of the fee. The H-1B visa program is crucial for employers seeking specialized talent from abroad, and the fee's imposition has faced significant legal scrutiny.

world.title: Iran’s Disappearing Oil Is Becoming Everyone’s Problem
world.summary: Iran's declining oil exports are impacting global markets, particularly as China's demand for crude increases. The reduction in Iranian oil threatens to disrupt the Strait of Hormuz, through which 13 million barrels per day flow. This situation raises concerns about potential price shocks in the global oil market, as buyers compete for limited supplies amid geopolitical tensions.

business.title: Stock Market Today: All You Need To Know Before Going Into Trade On Oct 1
business.summary: On October 1, the stock market experienced a decline, with the Nifty 50 falling 95 points to 22,620, marking its lowest level since March and a three-day losing streak. Key brokerage calls and trade setups are highlighted for investors. Market participants are advised to stay informed about stocks in the news and overall market trends before trading.

business.title: Stocks in news: Infosys, HDFC Bank, Jio Financial, IRFC, NCC and Blue Dart
business.summary: Indian equity benchmarks fell over two sessions, driven by profit booking and rising oil prices. The Nifty 50 index closed down by 95.75 points at 22,620.45. Jio Financial Services and Allianz Europe B.V. invested in their joint venture for business operations. Additionally, Infosys expanded its partnership with ABN AMRO to enhance AI-driven transformation initiatives.

business.title: Foreign insurers welcome, but policy unclear
business.summary: Foreign insurers are preparing for upcoming policy changes in India's insurance market, which remains uncertain. The Indian insurance sector has been evolving, attracting international interest, yet the specifics of these changes are not clearly defined. This situation reflects the ongoing developments within one of the world's fastest-growing economies, as foreign companies seek to navigate the regulatory landscape.

technology.title: Emulation already solved the problem DLSS 5 is selling, and it did it for free years ago
technology.summary: Emulators have been providing free remasters of games without compromising frame rates, addressing issues similar to those marketed by DLSS 5. Users have successfully integrated DLSS 5 into various games by utilizing tools like ReShade or replacing existing DLSS files with Neural Rendering variants. This practice has allowed for enhanced visual experiences of classic games, showcasing the capabilities of emulation.

technology.title: Tech launches in October 2026: Vivo S2 FE, Motorola Edge 70 Neo, Google Fitbit Air
technology.summary: In October 2026, the technology sector will see multiple product launches in India, coinciding with the Diwali shopping season. Notable releases include the Vivo S2 FE, Motorola Edge 70 Neo, Lenovo Googlebook, Vivo V80, Microsoft Surface Mouse, and Google Fitbit Air. These new devices aim to cater to consumer demand during the festive period.

technology.title: Gotta Go Fast and Hunt Demons This October in These Free PlayStation Plus Games
technology.summary: In October, PlayStation Plus subscribers can enjoy free access to the game Hunt: Showdown 1896, which features monster hunting, aligning with the Halloween season. The game offers a thrilling experience, perfect for the longer nights and spooky atmosphere of the month. Players can immerse themselves in ghost stories and confront ghouls and monsters from the comfort of home.

sports.title: Green, Renshaw pick up injuries ahead of Test series
sports.summary: Australia's cricket team faces injury concerns ahead of the Test series, with Cameron Green sustaining a groin injury while batting and unable to field, despite plans to bowl. Meanwhile, Matt Renshaw left the field due to a wrist injury and did not return. Both players' conditions will be monitored as the team prepares for upcoming matches.

sports.title: Asian Games 2026 Day 12 Live Updates: India's day to begin with medal events in archery, taekwondo, shooting
sports.summary: On Day 12 of the Asian Games 2026, India will compete in archery, taekwondo, shooting, hockey, cricket, and wrestling. The men's hockey and volleyball teams are set to face Pakistan. India secured four gold medals on the previous day, moving up to eighth place in the overall standings. Live updates will be available throughout the day's events.

sports.title: India vs West Indies: Shubman Gill hits 223 not out on day of records as hosts chase down 406 to beat West Indies in second ODI
sports.summary: India successfully chased down 406 runs, defeating West Indies by eight wickets in the second ODI, marking the second highest successful run chase in ODI history. Shubman Gill scored 223 not out off 133 balls, while Rohit Sharma contributed significantly with 255 runs off 158 balls. The match showcased numerous batting records in front of a capacity crowd.

health.title: Hearing Loss in the Elderly
health.summary: On October 1, 2026, the International Day of Older Persons highlights the often-overlooked issue of hearing loss among the elderly. As people age, they experience various changes, including auditory decline. This condition can significantly impact their quality of life and social interactions. Awareness and attention to hearing health are essential for improving the well-being of older adults.

health.title: WHO announces expansion of prequalification programme for medical devices
health.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) has expanded its prequalification programme to encompass a broader array of life-saving medical devices. This includes contraceptives and innovative technologies for tuberculosis screening. The initiative aims to improve access to essential medical tools in various health systems, enhancing the quality of care and supporting global health efforts in combating diseases.

health.title: Microsoft : How AI could help scientists find viruses to fight drug-resistant infections
health.summary: Microsoft is exploring how artificial intelligence can assist scientists in identifying bacteriophages, viruses that target bacteria, as a potential solution to combat drug-resistant infections. These infections pose a significant threat to global health, necessitating innovative treatments when traditional antibiotics fail. The use of AI may enhance the discovery and application of these phages in medical research.

science.title: Cold War Spy Satellite FARRAH III Breaks Apart in Orbit, Cause Unknown
science.summary: The Cold War-era spy satellite USA-32, known as FARRAH III, disintegrated in low-Earth orbit on September 13, 2026, at approximately 2113 UTC. The satellite, launched during the Reagan administration, scattered debris at an altitude of 775 kilometers. U.S. Space Forces–Space confirmed the fragmentation event, but the cause of the breakup remains unknown.

science.title: Plants can sense touch, and scientists have discovered what happens next
science.summary: Scientists have found that plants can sense touch within a minute, activating protein signals that alter gene activity and influence subsequent growth. While plants appear stationary, they constantly interact with their environment, responding to factors like wind, rain, and animal contact. This ability to sense touch is crucial for their survival, as they cannot move away from external forces.

science.title: Butterfly Wing Patterns Create 'Motion Illusion' That Throws Off Predator Attacks
science.summary: A study by researchers from the University of Exeter and the University of Essex, published in Nature, reveals that butterfly wing patterns serve as advanced defense mechanisms. These vivid patterns, combined with the butterflies' wingbeats, create a "motion illusion" that confuses predators, enhancing the butterflies' chances of evading attacks. This research highlights the evolutionary significance of these visual adaptations.

entertainment.title: Monthly Horoscope: October 2026
entertainment.summary: In October 2026, Taurus is advised to ease their grip on various aspects of life, including relationships and finances. The month emphasizes the importance of letting go of fear and insecurity, suggesting that a more relaxed approach may lead to better outcomes. Holding too tightly to situations may create challenges, highlighting the need for balance and adaptability.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: October 1, 2026
entertainment.summary: On October 1, 2026, horoscopes suggest that Pisces should focus on decluttering various aspects of life, including routines and schedules. The current feelings of stagnation may stem from tolerating unsatisfactory situations for too long. The advice emphasizes the importance of simplifying life to enhance overall well-being and clarity, rather than seeking new productivity methods or skills.

entertainment.title: Capricorn Horoscope Today: October 1, 2026
entertainment.summary: Capricorns are encouraged to embrace new opportunities and explore beyond their current achievements. While hard work has brought them to this point, it should not be the sole reason to stay. The horoscope suggests that there is much to look forward to, highlighting their strength in observation and awareness, which can lead to positive developments in their lives.
